descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B24 · P1 · 已知

删除：医院用的是浏览器自带的确认框，删除后没有「已删除」提示；养老院根本没法删除住户

票：TFA-92579 AC7 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S16, OAT-06/S22

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S17 「Cancel 对 OK × 医院对养老院，在有相似名字的列表上：OK 正好删掉那一张卡片，提示点出它的名字，它的病历网址失效，旁边的病人还在」 Cancel vs OK × Hospital vs Nursing Home on a look-alike list: OK removes exactly that card, the toast names it, its chart URL is dead, the neighbour survives

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T6 On delete, a confirmation message in the same app-style UI says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted".（TFA-92579 AC 8）
  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK.（TFA-92579 AC 7）
  • T2 Deleting a patient removes all of that patient's data immediately (hard delete, not hidden); the audit log of who accessed the chart is kept.（TFA-92579 AC 2；UAT TC-24）
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-01；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given seededCensus look-alikes: H1 Ana Rivera and H2 Ben Rivera; N1 Dora Nguyen and N2 Hoa Nguyen. The agent notes the deleted patient's chart URL before deleting

When Nursing Home first: trash on Hoa's card → OK, snapshot at once; open Hoa's noted chart URL; open Dora's chart. Then Hospital: trash on Ben's card → OK, snapshot; open Ben's URL; open Ana's chart

Then Only the tapped card is gone; the in-app toast reads "<deleted name>'s patient card was deleted"; the old chart URL shows 'not found' and none of the deleted patient's data; the neighbour's card and chart (room, diagnosis) are intact

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Table: Cancel → card stays, no toast (S16); OK → that card gone + toast naming it + 'not found' at its URL + neighbour intact. oracle.mjs: after-OK mustContain 'Open chart for <neighbour>' and the one string "<deleted>'s patient card was deleted", mustNotContain 'Open chart for <deleted>', "<neighbour>'s patient card was deleted" and 'native dialog:'; …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa

医院病人确认删除后，没有出现「<姓名>'s patient card was deleted」提示；确认用的是浏览器自带的框，养老院卡片也没法删除。

After a Hospital delete is confirmed, no "<Name>'s patient card was deleted" message appears; the confirm is the browser's own box, and Nursing Home cards cannot be deleted at all.

依据：datasets lane (identity dataset). The native confirm and the missing NH trash icon are dev report §2 #7 / U09. The missing toast (AC 8) is not called out in §2, but ledger U09 says ACs 2/4/7/8 have no PR, and matrix Q8 expects them to fail. The exact toast wording is Q7.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。
